text:
Maria Chen: Thanks for coming to the security segment — dropping the live Q&A here so we can track owners and timelines.
Sanjay Patel: Quick one on evidence bundles for auditors: who assembles the packages (policies, system configs, logs) and how often do we refresh?
Alex Rivera: Also: retention windows for audit logs and whether customers can request full exports for their compliance teams.
Jess Liu: ISO question: are we planning a separate ISO27001 run or using SOC2 artifacts as a baseline? Any target quarter?
Tyler Nguyen: BYOK scope: leadership asked if Dedicated and Private installs will allow customer keys, and whether hosted customers can ever BYOK.
Priya Rao: From Privacy: we need clarity on redaction rules for exported logs (PII masking) before we promise anything to EU customers.
Sanjay Patel: Short answers: 1) Evidence bundles — monthly canonical snapshots maintained by Security, with ad-hoc exports for customer audits (export SLA tbd). Security owns packaging, Eng/oncall provides automation.
Sanjay Patel: 2) Retention tiers — default 90d, enterprise tiers 1y/3y/7y with S3/GCS export connectors. We'll add TTL configs per tenant.
Alex Rivera: Draft export record (JSONL) we propose: {"ts":"2026-03-23T17:10:05Z","req_id":"req_XYZ","actor":"user:team-acme","route":"/v1/chat","model":"redwood/gpt-13b","tokens_in":18,"tokens_out":120,"status":"ok","region":"us-west1","kms_key":"projects/..../keys/k1"} — includes rotation-proof events.
Jess Liu: ISO plan: target Q4 readiness window, run parallel controls assessment. We'll reuse SOC2 artifacts where applicable but expect additional supplier-assessment evidence. I'll own the gap list.
Tyler Nguyen: BYOK timeline: Private/VPC BYOK doable sooner (target Q3) because key material stays customer-side. Hosted BYOK needs HSM/BYOQ design and legal policy updates — target Q4 earliest with gating on security review.
Priya Rao: For exports: require configurable PII redaction and a privacy sign-off step. Legal to approve per-region export policies.
legal-bot: Note: pending review required for cross-border log exports; please file a privacy review ticket with Legal before customer commitments.
Maria Chen: Action items captured: 1) @Sanjay publish evidence-bundle cadence + export SLA proposal (EOD Mon). 2) @Jess deliver ISO gap matrix and supplier assessment plan (end of week). 3) @Alex produce audit-export schema + sample file and include rotation/proof events. 4) @Tyler draft BYOK roadmap by deployment type, include gating items. 5) @Priya/Legal to define redaction requirements and approve export procedures.
Sanjay Patel: I'll schedule a short ops sync to show how evidence artifacts are collected and where we need automation.
Alex Rivera: I'll open a docs PR with the JSONL schema and tag security/privacy for review.
Jess Liu: Will coordinate with VendorOps for supplier questionnaires and compile evidence templates.
Tyler Nguyen: Will add BYOK notes to the public security FAQ draft but mark as "pre-release" until Legal signs off.
Priya Rao: Will define minimal PII redaction rules and escalate edge-cases to Legal.
Maria Chen: Thanks — please update this thread with links to PRs and tickets as they land. If leadership wants a one-pager for GTM, @Alex and @Tyler can pair on messaging. :raised_hands:
